_comment: Permanent site-wide notice shown under the bar (public/js/boot.js). Set enabled=false to hide it. The SITE_NOTICE env var overrides text (SITE_NOTICE=off hides it) without a deploy. action 'timeline' focuses the timeline scrubber; href opens a link instead. Dismissals are per message text.
text: The 2026 midterms are over. This dashboard now works as a record of election night: drag the timeline to replay any moment of the count, the markets, the news and the streams as they were.
